messages:
Maya: Customer ask — Console page showing estimated spend by tenant with a one-click link to traces. Minimal SDK changes preferred.
Liam: Do they want exact invoice numbers or an engineer-facing estimate?
Maya: Estimate is fine, used to find hot customers and jump to traces.
Priya: Implementation sketch: add span tags `tenant_hash`, `route`, `model_variant` and root tag `est_usd`. Emit a compact telemetry row for optional export.
Noah: Sampling: keep global low rate; add dynamic rule to force-collect when `est_usd` > threshold or tenant is in beta. Need retention caps for non-beta tenants.
Zoe: UX: "Top estimated spenders" table, pivot by model/route, timepicker, and a drill action that opens trace viewer with cost spans highlighted. Tooltip: "Estimate at request time; final billed amount may differ."
Dina: Compliance: exports off by default; opt-in only after signed agreements. We'll avoid PII and store only hashed tenant IDs. I'll own legal checklist.
Liam: Export schema proposal: `ts, tenant_hash, model_variant, route, tokens_est, est_usd, trace_id, batch_id`. I can own versioning.
Priya: Phased plan: Phase 0 add `model`+`route` tags (hotfix). Phase 1 add `est_usd` + internal dashboard + reconciliation job. Phase 2 GA with opt-in BigQuery export + SDK ergonomics.
Noah: Estimates: infra 1w for dynamic sampling + retention; backend 2w for collector/export; UI 1.5w. SDK patches small per language.
Maya: Acceptance criteria for beta: dashboard with pivot & drill, trace linkouts highlighting cost spans, export opt-in writes to BigQuery for signed customers, docs and runbook.
Liam: Ops: feature flag gating, audit logs for exports, and nightly reconciliation comparing estimates to billing for top tenants.
Priya: Dev note: annotate traces with `batch_id` so we can reconcile when batching affects billing.
Maya: Owners: Maya (PM), Priya (SDK/backend), Noah (ingest/sampling), Liam (export/schema), Zoe (UX), Dina (legal). I'll follow up with a 30m scope meeting.
